pageTitle: Ku biir Koox · The Water Check
invitedBody: Biyo wada cabba oo is dhiirrigeliya. Fur abka si aad ugu biirto, ama koodhkan ku qor qaybta Koox.
noApp: Abka weli ma haysatid? The Water Check waxay imanaysaa App Store iyo Google Play. Markaad hesho, mar kale fur linkigan ama ku biir koodhka.
incompleteBody: Saaxiibkaa ka codso inuu mar kale kuu soo diro casuumaadda, ama ku biir koodhka uu kuu soo diray, adigoo isticmaalaya qaybta Koox ee abka.
